mechanisms.label: Code-cell / program control
mechanisms.definition: The controller writes or executes a multi-action program; note distinguishes online cells from offline compiled policies.

mechanisms.label: Robot shell / CLI access
mechanisms.definition: Robot operations are accessed through an OS terminal, shell or explicit robot CLI; a coding-agent brand alone does not establish this.

mechanisms.label: Repair or critic agent
mechanisms.definition: An explicit repair/coding/critic role revises an artifact or diagnoses failed execution; not merely retries within one action loop.

mechanisms.label: Persistent skills / lessons
mechanisms.definition: Reusable written code, skills, rules or lessons persist beyond one episode; within-episode history alone does not qualify.

mechanisms.label: RGB triangulation
mechanisms.definition: Explicit multi-view or temporal ray triangulation from calibrated RGB; depth backprojection and ray-plane intersection alone do not qualify.

mechanisms.label: Wrist-camera re-view
mechanisms.definition: Explicit wrist-view inspection/reinspection; note distinguishes physical camera repositioning from a passive wrist observation.

mechanisms.label: Visual differencing
mechanisms.definition: Explicit difference/change representation comparing images, rather than generic fresh observation or a visual critic.

mechanisms.label: Exploration / practice phase
mechanisms.definition: Dedicated physical/simulated practice or development rollouts precede a distinct retained/frozen evaluation artifact.

mechanisms.label: Multiple candidate reasoning / search
mechanisms.definition: Explicit multiple candidate agents/models/programs or search populations combined/selected; separate planner and critic roles alone do not count.

mechanisms.label: Distilled coder / tool agent
mechanisms.definition: A smaller coder or reasoning/tool-call model is trained on validated teacher traces; RL-only training and motor-policy distillation are excluded.

mechanisms.label: Prompt / KV caching
mechanisms.definition: Use of prompt-prefix or KV caching is explicitly reported; ordinary inference context is insufficient evidence.

mechanisms.label: Geometric preview / overlay

build_recommendations.name: Bounded persistent Python runtime
build_recommendations.change: One model response may inspect cached sensor files, call geometry tools, execute several guarded motions, evaluate measured effects and retry locally. Keep joint/EEF safety checks below the program. Bound native steps, wall time and retries; yield compact evidence at physical checkpoints.
build_recommendations.measure: Paired comparison with the existing per-step loop, holding observations, perception tools, model and physical budget fixed.

build_recommendations.name: Calibrated geometry and evidence
build_recommendations.change: Expose synchronized RGB frames, intrinsics/extrinsics, robot pose, gripper width and source timestamps. Add cross-view triangulation with reprojection residual/uncertainty, known-table ray intersection, projected gripper/target overlays, and physically move the wrist when baseline or visibility is inadequate.
build_recommendations.measure: Separate interface gain from added sensing. Compare passive stereo, an equal-budget physical re-view and the same images without calibrated geometry.

build_recommendations.name: Effect checks and adaptive handoff
build_recommendations.change: Use explicit local guards for reach, grasp-width change, object motion, release and settling. Continue routine free-space segments locally; ask the model when uncertainty, contact mismatch, stall, occlusion or a phase transition warrants it. Use available native modalities only.
build_recommendations.measure: Keep the total sensing/motion budget equal; report model calls saved and paired SR changes. No benchmark success function in runtime decisions.

build_recommendations.name: Verified repair and retained capabilities
build_recommendations.change: A separate episode reviewer proposes one minimal tool/skill change with evidence and a failure hypothesis. Run syntax/unit checks, paired physical development cases and a regression capability bank; then test the merged candidate. Freeze versioned code, prompts, calibration and skill manifests for held-out episodes.
build_recommendations.measure: Report rescued/lost pairs, per-task regressions, acquisition calls and dollars, and held-out SR. Keep raw log retrieval as a comparator to structured skill retrieval.

build_recommendations.name: Only then distill or compile
build_recommendations.change: Compile repeatedly successful bounded skills or train a small coder on validated successes, midtask recoveries and rejection decisions. Retain frontier-model fallback for uncertainty. Price data collection and failed acquisition attempts as well as deployment.
build_recommendations.measure: Compare the same API, skills, sensor access and episode budget; estimate break-even using acquisition cost divided by measured per-episode savings.

proposed_experiments.name: Separate code execution from better tools
proposed_experiments.design: A 2x2 experiment: per-step versus bounded code; current versus calibrated geometry/effect tools. Six representative tasks x 20 paired held-out layouts x four conditions = 480 episodes, after distinct development scenes.
proposed_experiments.why: PyRUA supports code representation, while URAI and Guava show that useful runtime decisions and feedback cadence can outweigh batching. This design identifies the interaction in controlr's own setting.

proposed_experiments.name: Uncertainty-triggered physical re-view
proposed_experiments.design: Under the same action/image budget, compare fixed passive stereo, always taking a wrist re-view and re-view only above a triangulation uncertainty/occlusion threshold.
proposed_experiments.why: CodeActionBench and PhysEvo use physical re-views, but no matched RoboDojo ablation isolating the uncertainty trigger was verified.

proposed_experiments.name: Calibration-dependent skill invalidation
proposed_experiments.design: Attach camera/tool-tip/gripper calibration versions to every retained skill. Perturb one estimate in development; compare blindly retained skills, whole-library invalidation and dependency-specific revalidation.
proposed_experiments.why: KnowBody motivates dependency tracking; its effect on a RoboDojo coding-agent skill library remains unverified.

proposed_experiments.name: Execution acknowledgments and stale-image rejection
proposed_experiments.design: Require every action to return an executed-step prefix and observation epoch. Inject realistic interrupted chunks or stale frames in development; compare continuation from planned actions against measured executed actions.
proposed_experiments.why: WorldScape and OpenETA contain related lifecycle controls; no matched independent RoboDojo success ablation was located.

proposed_experiments.name: Repair for another task, not just the failed task
proposed_experiments.design: Accept a candidate only after paired failure cases and a task-diverse capability bank; report seed holdout and task holdout separately. Compare generic tool repairs with task-specific recipes under equal acquisition budgets.
proposed_experiments.why: Most strong submissions retain task-specific engineering. RPG and SimEX support regression replay, but generic transfer versus task specialization is still incompletely separated.

proposed_experiments.name: Value per model call and per acquired skill
proposed_experiments.design: Compare fixed-step, phase-triggered and anomaly-triggered calls with all-attempt dollars/tokens/time per success. Include repair, abandoned generations, failed runs and API retries.
proposed_experiments.why: Existing costs often condition on successes or omit acquisition. robot-agent-eval already proposes related factorial designs, so this is a useful evidence gap, not an untouched idea.
